name: Koi Sanctuary
hint: Tap to feed. Drag a lily pad. The koi follow the food.

name: Clay Hour
hint: Drag either wall to shape wet clay. Fire the vessel to finish it.

name: Silk Memory
hint: Pull the cloth. Its woven threads hold, stretch and settle.

name: Balance in Air
hint: Drag a hanging shape. Release it and watch the whole mobile rebalance.

name: Tea for One
hint: Move and tilt the teapot over the cup. Stir the surface with a finger.

name: Aurora Dunes
hint: Sweep the sky to bend the curtains of light. Tap to place a star.

name: Rain Room
hint: Wipe the mist away to reveal the evening city. Raindrops slowly clear their own paths.
gesture: Wipe glass · reveal city · change rain

name: Lantern Jellies
hint: Lead a jellyfish by its bell. Its long tentacles follow the current.

name: Sand Ritual
hint: Rake parallel grooves. Switch tools to move stones, then draw rings around them.

name: Glass Orchard
hint: Move the lead joints to reshape individual glass cells. Shift the sunlight.

name: Pocket Meadow
hint: Plant a flower with a touch. Comb the meadow with the breeze or scatter drifting seeds.

name: Paper Aviary
hint: Touch to fold a paper bird. Pick one up and flick it into flight.

name: Tectonic Atlas
hint: Touch the land to raise hills, carve valleys or smooth the terrain. Turn the map.

name: Orbital Forge
hint: Drag backward and release to launch a planet. Let gravity draw its orbit.

name: Bubble Conservatory
hint: Hold empty space to blow a bubble. Drag to carry it. Tap an existing bubble to pop it.

name: Coral Architect
hint: Graft a new branch. Hold near growing tips to guide them. Switch to pruning to open space.

name: Constellation Harp
hint: Brush a string to set it vibrating. Move the stars to tune its geometry. Sound is optional.
gesture: Pluck strings · move stars · optional tones

name: Petal Lens
hint: Paint inside the lens. Turn its material into petals, sea glass or moth wings.

name: Tide Table
hint: Move shells by hand. Leave marks in the sand and raise the tide to wash them away.
gesture: Arrange shells · trace sand · raise tide

name: Portrait of Air
hint: Drag the mouth, brow or cheek to reshape an expression. The eyes follow your hand.
gesture: Shape expression · stretch face · change finish
